scripts.install: cd client && npm install --force && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.lint: cd frontend && bun run lint && cd ../backend && bun run lint
scripts.lint:fix: cd frontend && bun run lint --fix && cd ../backend && bun run lint:fix
scripts.format: cd frontend && bun run format && cd ../backend && bun run format
scripts.format:check: cd frontend && bun run format:check && cd ../backend && bun run format:check
